title: Quantum cohomology and split generation in Lagrangian Floer theory
summary: Given a finite collection of Lagrangian submanifolds $\mathscr L$ in a compact symplectic manifold $X$, we construct a cyclic, filtered, strictly unital curved $A_{\infty}$ category $\mathcal L$ and develop Floer theory of closed-open maps and open-closed maps.
